mapper.select: SELECT dv.id, dv.workspace_id, dv.document_id, dv.version_number, dv.content_sha256, dv.storage_key, dv.parser_version, dv.created_at FROM document_versions dv JOIN documents d ON d.workspace_id = dv.workspace_id AND d.id = dv.document_id WHERE dv.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND dv.content_sha256 = #{contentSha256} ORDER BY dv.created_at, dv.id LIMIT 1
